q: Which is NOT one of the four North Star dealbreakers?
why: The dealbreakers are customer value, leading, movable and free of vanity.

q: Why is monthly revenue not a North Star?

why: A completed lesson is real value, leads revenue, is movable and hard to fake.

q: 'Sessions per learner per week' is which BDEF input?
why: Frequency: how often they come back.

q: Daily active users is a good North Star because it's easy to measure.
why: Myth. It counts logins, not value, and is easy to inflate.
